verdict.rationale: LangGraph advertises native durable execution: agents persist through failures and resume from where they left off. Database-backed checkpointers (PostgresSaver) make thread state survive process restarts, the checkpointer writes exact state so runs can resume even from an error state, and the Agent Server includes a managed checkpointing database. Community comments confirm checkpointing is a core framework feature, while noting persistence could be better developed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of resuming in-flight runs across deploys/version changes, any evidence of third-party durable-execution integrations (e.g. Temporal-style), and hands-on corroboration of restart recovery.
